neighbours.label: word piece after 'St'/'est' in split words (St|ature, est|atura, St|air)
fire: El jugador mide mucho y su estatura es de 1,90 metros.
Children with short stature are sometimes treated with hormones.
La familia se agrupa escalonando estaturas y edades.
His stature in the party grew after the election.
The StairMaster in the gym was broken again.
Su estatura le ayuda a ganar los balones aéreos.
quiet: El jugador mide mucho y su peso es de 80 kilos.
Children with slow growth are sometimes treated with hormones.
La familia se agrupa ordenando edades y nombres.
His influence in the party grew after the election.
The treadmill in the gym was broken again.
Su altura le ayuda a ganar los balones aéreos.
